articleHeadline: 99.3% covered, 1,200 infected: Ghana's HIV blind spot
articleSummary: Ghana reports 1,200 babies born with HIV in 2024 via mother-to-child transmission, despite 99.3% PMTCT coverage. The disconnect between near-universal service coverage and infection outcomes shows uptake alone doesn’t ensure results; testing, result disclosure, linkage to care, timely ART initiation, and eighteen-month retention during pregnancy/breastfeeding are critical. Calls to action include: retire 'ignorance,' shift to undiagnosed/not yet reached, launch facts-over-fear messaging, elevate lived experiences, and implement stigma-free service design with private spaces and guaranteed confidentiality. Zero HIV Stigma Day reinforces year-round commitment.
